title: the fed JUST warned | hiking could be a big mistake
speaker: Kevin Paffrath (Meet Kevin)

macro_themes.theme: Fed hiking into AI inflation could be a mistake
macro_themes.view: Lisa Cook argues sector-specific AI price inflation should resolve as supply comes online; hiking into it risks a Greenspan-style mistake.
Outside geopolitics, AI supply, concentrated productivity gains, stagnant wages and job reallocation are all disinflationary/deflationary.
Thinks odds of no further hikes are ~30-40% (vs ~10% priced on Kalshi) if an Iran deal brings oil down and the Fed holds in October.
HBM price growth forecast to roll over in 2H27; Micron's forward pricing commentary is the tell.

calls.condition: Conditional on an Iran deal, which he expects ("I think it's going to happen")
calls.reason: Expects an Iran deal within ~5-6 weeks before the election, which could take oil from ~$105 to $70-80 with the Saudi East-West pipeline already open.
calls.quote: we get an Iran deal between now and then, and then all of a sudden, oil goes from $105 to $80 or $70

notes: Micron earnings "tomorrow" => recorded Tue Sep 29 (matches listing). Mostly a Fed/macro commentary; oil target given as a $70-80 range (no single target recorded).
